commitResults.messageTitle: Implement milestone resolution flow and refactor get /students to use StudentId
commitResults.messageBody:
- add read-side milestone model classes:
  - ResolvedMilestoneStatus
  - ResolvedMilestone
  - StudentMilestoneView
  - MilestoneResolver
- implement milestone resolution as a derived display layer on top of stored milestone data
- compute overdue status dynamically instead of storing it in MilestoneRecord
- treat missing student-assignment milestone entries as default NOT_STARTED records during resolution
- preserve assignment order when resolving milestones for display

- extend Model and ModelManager with getResolvedMilestones(StudentId)
- wire milestone resolution through the model layer so commands can retrieve display-ready milestone views

- add get /students <studentId> /milestones command flow
- add GetStudentMilestonesCommand and GetStudentMilestonesCommandParser
- update AddressBookParser to route milestone retrieval before normal student retrieval

- refactor get /students to use StudentId instead of displayed list index
- update GetStudentCommandParser to parse student IDs
- update GetStudentCommand to retrieve and filter students by StudentId
- standardise student lookup syntax to forms such as S1 and S2 instead of numeric indices
- align student retrieval command format with milestone feature design

commitResults.messageBody:
Refactor the AddCommand class to support the revised input and
message format for student entries.

Also add the StudentIndexPredicate class to enable filtering
students by index, improving support for index-based selection
and related command behaviour.

These changes align the add command parsing and user-facing
messages with the updated student command format while
introducing reusable predicate logic for student filtering."
